capabilities: Render a month-view grid from a code block
Punch days using dates with optional tags
Restrict the view width with CSS values
Enable HTML for links and images in days
extras: HTML parsing is off by default for security reasons and must be enabled in settings; the README notes a current Obsidian limitation preventing local images in tags.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize day-by-day habit punch records inside a note.
summary: Habit tracker that renders a month-view table of punched days from a code block in a note.
